tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google launches Playground, a new gaming platform that lets non-coders build games with text prompts. Confirmed by TechCrunch.
Microsoft and Nvidia CEOs have teamed up to launch the AI-powered Surface Laptop Ultra, featuring local processing capabilities. Reported by The Tech Buzz.
OpenAI's release of mathematical findings is drawing concerns from experts. Reported by The Guardian.
AIBound has launched AgentHarness, a security tool that enforces security rules inside artificial intelligence agents, blocking malicious actions before they occur. Reported by AiThority.
Armadin raised $255.5M in Series B funding and executed the largest artificial intelligence cyberattack using 26K agents targeting 25K services. Reported by Forkast News.
Free every hour.
